currency.rate_label: Local rate: 1 USD = how many CNY

currency.fix_json_first: Fix the JSON below before editing the currency or the rate.
currency.manual_rate_note: A manual rate that never updates from the network. Saving below applies it to every page and export and re-converts historical usage; the recorded price numbers stay unchanged. Each model price may set currency to USD or CNY, and the top-level JSON currency is used when it is omitted.

settings.subtitle: Every setting stays on this machine. Editing prices needs no rescan.
settings.autostart: Start after sign-in and stay in the tray
settings.roots_note: One absolute path per line. Codex accepts sessions, archived_sessions or another local log root; a SQLite source names its database file.
settings.save_runtime: Save runtime and data source settings
settings.prices_note: Prices are per million tokens in each entry's currency. A model may carry several effective-dated rates; an entry without effectiveFrom is the base price. Zero means free, and a missing model means unknown.
settings.example_note: The example rate and prices only show the format; they are not the current rate or an official price.
settings.prices_saved: Prices, currency and rate saved; query costs recalculated

quota.title: Codex quota · observed locally
quota.disclaimer: Each card shows the last log observation before the query end, not a live balance. Account quota cannot be split by model or project, and the token query range is not the quota billing window.
quota.reset_passed: Observed reset time has passed, waiting for newer logs
quota.no_windows: The logs offer no parseable quota window.
quota.history_summary: Quota observations in range · {{total}} log observations
quota.history_showing: Showing the latest {{shown}} observations, one row per window
quota.history_note: Uses the exact start and end (end exclusive); repeated archived observations are deduplicated. Only what the logs recorded is shown; a changing reset time is not evidence of a manual reset or a redeemed quota.
quota.history_empty: No parseable quota observation in this range and window.
quota.history_capped: The latest {{max}} observations are shown to keep the panel responsive. Narrow the minute range for older records.

summary.composition_note: . Share denominators are the whole filtered result set; cost shares stay hidden while unpriced usage is present. Effective unit price = cost from historical prices / total tokens x one million, not the current quote.
summary.composition_aria: Token composition: new input {{input}}, cached read {{cached}}, cache write {{cacheWrite}}, output {{output}}
summary.component_prices_note: Shown as — when not fully priced or when that component has no usage
summary.footnote: ¹ Reasoning tokens are already inside output and are not added twice. Costs come from the local prices.json. Click a header to sort; detail and export always use the whole query range, so paging never changes a total.

activity.note_order: newest first. Codex session replay shows arguments, output and patches.
